title: LauncherHiddenEntries
description: The desktop entries the launcher leaves out as package implementation details, each with the reason. One file read by both the launcher (Apps.qml) and `punarctl app list --all`, which lists them marked rather than hiding them, so the two surfaces never drift apart silently.

note.title: Note
note.description: Why this file exists, in prose, for whoever meets it next.

entries.title: Hidden entries
entries.description: Desktop-file id (lower-case, without .desktop) -> the reason the launcher hides it, shown by `punarctl app list --all`. Exact ids only, never a pattern.
